rows.notes: Single GET /companies/{symbol}/insider_transaction_filings; rows under key transaction_filings, then each filing's transactions[] array is exploded into one row per transaction with filing-level fields (filing_date/filing_url/issuer_ticker/issuer_cik/owner.*) copied onto every sub-row (transform_data lines 162-179). model_validator maps empty strings to None (line 111). limit aliased to page_size; no pagination loop despite page_size param; start_date defaults to now-5y.

One row assembled per symbol from 39 scalar GETs on /companies/{symbol}/data_point/{tag} (tags hardcoded lines 259-299); each response keyed by URL's last path segment and merged into one dict (callback line 313-315). Comma-separated symbols fan out concurrently. Bad-field dict responses are dropped in transform. period param other than annual is ignored with a warning. One path template, ~39 URLs per symbol.

amake_requests fan-out over symbol×tag URL cartesian product /companies/{symbol}/data_point/{tag} (generate_url lines 59-61); each response is one scalar value, callback builds one {symbol,tag,value} row per URL from URL path parts (lines 79-82). Error responses warn and drop the row. Not a true join - rows are concatenated fan-out results; shape word multi_endpoint_join chosen as closest existing term.

Step 1 GET /securities/snapshots (JSON) yields file URLs under snapshots[].files[].url (lines 168-177); step 2 concurrently downloads each URL as gzip-compressed bytes, gzip.decompress + read_csv (line 192). response_format recorded as csv because data rows come from the gzipped CSVs; zip_member_decoder used for gzip (canonical decode.archive_member). Epoch timestamps converted via safe_fromtimestamp and tz-converted (lines 218-235); fixed column selection (lines 203-216); Max/Min/0/NaN replaced with None (lines 241-247). Date param reformatted to ISO with forced 20:00 default time in transform_query.

GET /options/expirations/{symbol}/{eod|realtime} first (branch on query.delay, lines 230-235), then fan-out one GET /options/chain/{symbol}/{expiration}/{eod|realtime} per expiration; each item merged from option+price(+stats+extended_price) sub-dicts (lines 340, 352-357). EOD with date delegates to IntrinioEquityHistoricalFetcher, falling back to IntrinioIndexHistoricalFetcher, for the underlying close (lines 299-313). Previous-weekday date normalization and one-day-earlier retry when EOD empty (lines 282-286). Output validated as pandas orient=list columnar shape (line 376). SPX/SPXW symbol warning. 4 distinct path shapes: expirations, chain/eod|realtime, equity historical, index historical.

GET /options/snapshots (JSON) returns file URLs under snapshots[].files[].url; the first URL is downloaded as gzip bytes and parsed with read_csv (lines 196-217). COL_MAP renames 20 uppercase CSV headers (lines 234-256); unix-second timestamps to NY-time datetimes; underlying/expiration/type/strike derived by regex/string slicing of contract_symbol incl strike decimal scaling (lines 272-291); only_traded drives dropna on last_timestamp (lines 257-262); sorted by volume; final model validated on df.to_dict(orient=list) columnar shape (line 337). OCC symbol reconstruction (lines 318-333). zip_member_decoder records gzip decompression.

GET /options/unusual_activity[/{symbol}]/intraday - symbol present inserts a path segment (lines 237-242). Pagination loop follows next_page token from each JSON response appended as &next_page= query param until limit (1000-record pages, lines 258-274). Rows under key trades, client-side sorted by timestamp desc. underlying_price_at_execution 0 mapped to None. Weekend-proofing and non-inclusive end-date juggling in query validator. UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: next_page_cursor_pagination —— body_offset_pagination implies offset/body paging, but this endpoint paginates by a next_page token read from the previous response.

Two modes on GET /zacks/target_price_consensuses: comma-separated symbols fan out one identifier= request each (get_one, lines 109-128, no paging); no-symbol mode walks next_page cursor until exhausted (lines 131-149). paged=true records the cursor branch. Rows under key target_price_consensuses; transform double-sorts by most_recent_date then query symbol order and pops the nested company object. UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: next_page_cursor_pagination —— closest key body_offset_pagination does not describe response-embedded next_page token paging.

Step 1 GET /companies/{symbol}/fundamentals?statement_code=... returns ids list (page_size=10000, no cursor loop); statement_type branches into 3 statement_code values via STATEMENT_DICT. Ids filtered client-side on statement_code/fiscal_period with pandas before slicing to limit. Step 2 fans out GET /fundamentals/{id}/reported_financials per id; each financials[] array (tag/value pairs) flattened into one dynamic-column row via xbrl_tag -> snake_case field names (transform lines 131-145). Zero/empty values dropped. Fiscal year floored to 2008 with warning.

Single GET /data_tags/search with querystring incl limit aliased to page_size; rows under key tags. Upstream ignores page_size fidelity, so results are truncated client-side to query.limit (line 64, code comment calls it a temporary fix). Data aliases parent_name->parent, transaction->balance.

3 concurrent GETs /companies/{symbol}/data_point/{tag}/number for public_float, weightedavebasicdilutedsharesos, adjweightedavebasicdilutedsharesos; callback keys each scalar by URL path part (line 83) and all merge into ONE row dict with symbol + today's date. Not a join across datasets - one-row assembly from keyed parallel responses; single path template.

GET /companies/news with page_size=limit; callback walks next_page cursor appended as query param until limit reached (lines 219-227), de-duplicating articles by URL across pages, then client-sorts by publication_date desc and slices to limit (line 228). Rows under key news; transform flattens nested body{} (publication_date/body) onto each row and falls back to summary->text; ignore-list branches on source==yahoo. UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: next_page_cursor_pagination —— body_offset_pagination does not capture response-token cursor paging.
